Elite areas (aka non-instanced dungeons, micro dungeons, and half dungeons) are areas in a non-instanced zone full of elite creatures. These usually require a group to complete and are often the focus of group quests. As of Patch 2.3 most of these areas are no longer filled with elite creatures, but rather with normal mobs. With the current rarity of elite mobs, the terms mentioned above could be used to refer to any non-instanced questing area that is separated from its surroundings (caves, crypts, buildings, etc). In Mists of Pandaria, many areas like this with a distinct interior were given maps. See Micro dungeon maps. Current non-instanced dungeons include, by zone:

Elite mode (previously and informally called Hard mode), not to be confused with heroic mode, refers to the increase in difficulty of a raid boss encounter resulting in increased rewards and/or achievements. This is accomplished by doing or not doing certain things that increase the difficulty of the boss fight. It is not possible to set an encounter to elite mode from the user interface (as compared to Heroic mode where it is possible), rather, specific objectives in the encounter must be completed to enable elite mode. While Eli helped him in trade, his heart was never in it. One day an elf entered Nori's shop to make an order. Eli was suspicious of the elf, for he asked for a discreet midnight transaction, but Nori simply rebuffed Eli. Elite has several means in World of Warcraft: * Elite creature: A tougher type of creature than normal. * Elite mode: A tougher version of a raid encounter, informally and previously called "Hard mode". Not to be confused with Heroic mode, which is comparatively harder (Normal < Elite < Heroic < Heroic Elite) * Elite areas: Uninstanced areas on the open world that (until Patch 2.3) were filled with elite creatures. Also called micro dungeons. * Elite quest, now called a "Group quest".

There are four known elven dialects. This was possibly (before the non-canonization of the RPG) the fourth named elven dialect after Darnassian, Thalassian, and Nazja. It is possible that the fourth dialect is the nightborne language, which is distinct from both modern Darnassian and Thalassian. Elven is a unique and obscure language. It is known by the half-elf banshee Ielephia and some inhabitants living on Mount Hyjal. This language is not to be confused with Thalassian which is sometimes referred to as "High Elven" by individuals who are unfamiliar with its proper name.

Emberstrife's Den is a sizable cave in the Wyrmbog region of southern Dustwallow Marsh. It is the home of the Black drake Emberstrife, who puts young black dragonlings through vigorous tests in order to become esteemed enough to enter Onyxia's Lair.

Elu is a tauren quest giver located in Freewind Post in Thousand Needles. Elu was an aspiring Wind Rider Master and had a great love and respect for the wyverns. He has been missing since the Cataclysm, presumably having been killed in the Thousand Needles disaster.
The Embalmed Shroud is a cloth hood that gives a bonus to stamina, intellect, and spell damage.

Emberglade is an area in the northeast part of Azuremyst Isle, that is filled with friendly fire elementals. The landscape is a burnt ring of trees, with only a few remaining grass blades and the occasional stone. A fire elemental named Temper is located here. Temper is the end point for the quest Call of Fire Shaman quest.
__NOTOC__ Ember Worgs are worgs found in the Burning Steppes.
Elrendar River is a river in Quel'Thalas that forms the border between Eversong Woods and the Ghostlands. It it the largest river in Quel'Thalas, and empties out of Lake Elrendar.
Elrendar Crossing is the bridge spanning the Elrendar River at the border between Eversong Woods and the Ghostlands.
Elven Spirit Claws are a world drop in high-level Classic-era content, with an increased drop change from Ragnaros in the Molten Core and Nefarian in Blackwing Lair.

An Elune Stone creates a circular pillar of light that can mark a spot on the ground. Bring the light of Elune to your next dance party! __NOTOC__

Elunarian Cloak is a green cloak which could drop anywhere within the highest pre-World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade instances and zones. Its name is a reference to Elune, the kaldorei goddess. Due to its stats, only classes that engage in physical combat should find this an ideal cloak.
Elunarian Sarong is a world drop from Silithus and Ahn'Qiraj.

The elven horse is a breed of horse bred by the high elves. According to the elves, generations of breeding have created an animal far superior to its mundane cousins. Each rider is said to be in tune with their horse, so much so that a simple grunt from the animal could alert the rider to danger.
Embalming Fluid is found in Burial Chests in the Amani Catacombs in the Ghostlands.
__NOTOC__ Embelar is a blood elf fruit and drink vendor located in Halaa in Nagrand. He is only available when the Horde controls Halaa.

The Ember of Azzinoth is summoned through the proc of Shard of Azzinoth.

Emalon the Storm Watcher is a raid boss in the Vault of Archavon which he guards with deadly determination. He can be found in the eastern wing. He carries pieces of Tier 8 loot and PvP gear, similar to the Tier 7 loot dropped by Archavon. Like Archavon, Emalon is only available to the faction that controls Wintergrasp Fortress. Also like Archavon, Emalon becomes un-attackable ten minutes before each fight for Wintergrasp starts. He does not become un-attackable if he is already engaged in combat. Embersilk Net is created with Cataclysm Tailoring (1); taught by trainers.
Embercrusher Grips is a quest reward from Black Heart of Flame.
Elreth's Hand Mirror is provided as an objective for The Truth of the Grave.
Ember Worg Hides drop from Ember Worg and Giant Ember Worg in the Blasted Lands.

Emberstone Mine is a mine in northeastern Gilneas. The Forsaken enslaved the inhabitants of Emberstone Village and forced them to mine what is presumably coal. The mine was run by Brothogg the Slavemaster and the Forsaken Slavedrivers. In the Ruins of Gilneas Emberstone Mine is void of life after the worgen heroes rescued the villagers and killed the slavemaster, so it serves no purpose during this point of time.

Emberstone Village is a village along the Northgate River in northeastern Gilneas. It survived the worgen curse only to be invaded by the Forsaken. The villagers that did not escape were enslaved and forced to work in the nearby Emberstone Mine. Worgen heroes, after having rescued some of the villagers from the mine, then provided to the village itself to kill the Forsaken Infantry and their leaders, Executor Cornell and Valnov the Mad. In the Ruins of Gilneas, when the Horde entered the village in order to meet up with Deathstalker Commander Belmont and Arthura, the area was scattered with the corpses of these same Forsaken infantry.
Embersilk Bag is created with Cataclysm Tailoring (30); taught by trainers.
Emberstone Breastplate is a quest reward from the quest Fall Back!.
An Emaciated Felblood is a former Felblood Initiate who have had the fel energy drained which they had drawn from Suspended Terrorguards at the Throne of Kil'jaeden in Hellfire Peninsula.

Elwynn Forest is a level 1-20 zone, the starting zone for humans. For the quests in Elwynn Forest before the Cataclysm, see Elwynn Forest (Classic) quests. Ever since the fall of the Defias Brotherhood, these vast woodlands became far more tranquil. Nonetheless, this region, with Goldshire at the crossroads in its heart, is the prime location for trading. Most residents of Elwynn are involved in one of its major industries: logging, farming, fishing, or mining; they provide the capital, to the west, with a constant stream of food and supplies. Emaciated Mammoths are mammoths found in Dragonblight. They also appear in Dragonblight during the Hour of Twilight.
Emaciated Mammoth Bulls are mammoths found in Dragonblight. They also appear in Dragonblight during the Hour of Twilight.
Embers are fire elementals found in Gnomeregan. They are summoned by Burning Servants.

Emberspit Scorpions are level 85 scorpions found in the Molten Front.
Embercores are found in Ragefire Core in the Secrets of Ragefire. They appear after interacting with the Battery.

Emberbark Ancients are located in Tangleheart in the Gorgrond.

Emberfall Tower is a subzone of Ashran, and the northernmost tower of the Road of Glory. A curving path leads south down to Volrath's Advance, while to the north a narrow bridge leads across a ravine to the Horde base of Warspear Outpost. To the east lies Brute's Rise, while a smaller path leads southeast down to the Dark Woods. To the west the Horde Mine Entrance and Amphitheater of Annihilation can be found. Atop the Emberfall Tower itself stands the Warspear Tower Guardian Jeron Emberfall, ready to launch summoned phoenixes to explode upon the heads of any attackers who should breach the zone. Emberfall Watch is a subzone of Ashran, the physical tower found in the Emberfall Tower subzone. It is from the Emberfall Watch that the Horde Tower Guardian Jeron Emberfall surveys the battle below, guarded by two Lava Furies.

Embaari Village is a draenei settlement located in the central part of , west of Karabor and south of Elodor. Embaari is a center of trade, and its ranchers also domesticate talbuks and elekks for use in and other draenei settlements. The village also supports the practical needs of Teluuna Observatory's researchers. The merchant town is known for its delicious food and exotic wares. Embaari is eventually attacked by the , with the goal of taking enough prisoners to Anguish Fortress, but the attack was repelled.

Ely Cannon is the art director (formerly a senior level designer) for World of Warcraft. He has worked on World of Warcraft since The Burning Crusade and has been involved in the creation of more than 50 different in-game zones.

Out of the mysterious forests of Quel'thalas come the Elven Archers to aid the Alliance in its darkest hour. Descendants of the elder race of Lordaeron, these sylvan woodsmen are unmatched in their use of the bow. Unencumbered by helm or heavy armor, Archers are keen of eye and fleet of foot. These Elves have long been embroiled in a bloody conflict with the hated Trolls of Lordaeron and are swift to let loose a rain of arrows upon any foe, including those that attack from the skies above.
Elumm is a draenei quest giver located at the Pilgrim's Road in Talador.
